text:
Alex: Taking the 2pm release slot to roll out feature/x. It includes a small DB migration (adds index + backfill on jobs table). Minimal downtime expected but want a smoke owner and a quick rollback plan agreed.
Maria: Thanks — noted. Who's owning the migration step and the smoke tests?
Alex: I will run the migration. Planning canary at 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then full. Smoke checklist: health endpoints, primary write path, background worker queue.
Chen: I can be smoke owner for the first 25m window. Will watch metrics and run the smoke script. Can you drop the runbook link?
Alex: Runbook snippet: ```steps:
1) kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:feature-x
2) run migration: ./scripts/migrate --target=jobs --batch-size=5000
3) enable canary via traffic switch: rb config set canary=5
``` Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-feature-x :eyes:
Sam: Quick question — that backfill could touch ~20M rows. Any chance we need a row-locking window or need to use the low-priority backfill mode?
Alex: Good call. We'll use the async backfill job that paginates by id and sets low priority. I set --batch-size=5k and rate-limit in the script. No exclusive locks.
Nina: For rollback: what's the plan if the backfill causes slowness?
Alex: Rollback plan: 1) disable inbound traffic to new replica via routing (rb config set canary=0) 2) rollback image to previous tag: kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:stable-20260210 3) run pause on backfill jobs: ./scripts/backfill-control pause
Maria: Add a quick ops checklist item to ensure DB replica lag is < 2s before promoting. I can check that 10 mins before slot.
Chen: I'll run the smoke script and post results to this thread. Quick smoke script: ```./scripts/smoke -e prod --checks health,write,queue --samples 30```
deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed: build#4589, canary preview created, image: redwood/api:feature-x (sha: ab12cd). Deploy window scheduled at 2026-03-18T14:00Z.
Sam: Who's on-call for infra if network hiccups occur? @Maria are you okay to escalate?
Maria: Yep I'll be on standby and can call infra oncall if needed.
Alex: Thanks all. Chen — ping here when smoke passes/fails. If all green by +40m we'll proceed to full. If any perf regression, rollback steps above and notify infra. :white_check_mark:
Chen: Will do. Posting first smoke output in ~20m.
Nina: FYI I added a quick dashboard link for CPU/latency to my bookmarks and shared with the team: https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/feature-x
Alex: Appreciate it. Minimal chatter during the rollout please so alerts are easy to spot.
Chen: Smoke pass: health 30/30, write samples 28/30 (2 timeouts, investigating), queue length stable. Posting logs: ```trace id: 0a1b status: partial_timeouts```
Alex: Thanks — Sam can you help triage the 2 timeouts (likely transient)? If they persist after 5m we rollback.
Sam: On it, looking at logs now.
Chen: Update: timeouts were due to one pod hitting GC pause, bounced the pod and re-ran checks. All green now.
Alex: Excellent. Proceeding to 25% step in 2m. Will update here at each step. :rocket:
